doc.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02

chapter: De De's career and trumpet players
title: When De De first heard Louis Armstrong
summary: De De says he did not know Armstrong as a boy and remembers Celestin's parade bands from that time.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: When did you first hear Louis Armstrong?
We, I just made a trip here, it's been so many years back though. Yeah, I made noise.
Was it before the First World War? Do you remember? Did you hear him when he was a little kid or?

No, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no. I don't remember him during that time, no. It was way after that. After that, then got, what was it, their families anyway. Yes. Yeah, but I never knew him then before.
You never saw him on the street in the parades?

No, no, no, no, no, no. I think he played with the tuxedo band. No, no, I don't remember him then, no, no. I mostly remember Celestan or like that during that time, you know. Did you ever? Yeah, I did a parades and all like that at that time.
